تنتهبوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَهِبُوا (tantahibū) /tan.ta.hi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
# تُنْتَهَبُوا (tuntahabū) /tun.ta.ha.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَبَ (intahaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
